title: Call Centre Handler
description:
Call Centre Agent

Location: Bradford
Salary: Up to £30k (DOE)
Job Type: Full Time

Are you passionate about providing exceptional customer service? We're looking for a Call Centre Agent to join a busy and supportive Customer Operations team, helping customers across a variety of communication channels while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

The Role

As a Call Centre Agent, you'll manage customer enquiries from start to finish, taking ownership of cases and ensuring every interaction is handled professionally. You'll support customers via telephone, email, webchat and other digital channels, providing efficient resolutions and excellent service.

Key Responsibilities
- Handle customer enquiries across phone, email, webchat and digital channels.
- Take ownership of customer cases through to resolution.
- Assist with account queries, appointments and general service requests.
- Resolve complaints while managing customer expectations.
- Maintain accurate records using CRM systems.
- Work closely with internal teams to deliver timely resolutions.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and service delivery.

About You
- Minimum of 2 years' experience in a customer service role.
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
- Comfortable working across multiple communication channels.
- Customer-focused, organised and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
- A proactive team player with a positive attitude.
- Experience within utilities or energy is beneficial but not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary.
- 25 days holiday + BH
- Hybrid working
- Full training and ongoing development.
- Supportive team environment.
- Career progression opportunities.
- A varied and rewarding role where no two days are the same.

If you're looking for your next customer service opportunity and enjoy helping customers while working in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Part-time Administrator
description:
Part-time Rota & Staff Engagement Administrator

£14.36 per hour 25 hours Monday-Friday - these hours may increase Immediate Start Temp-to-Perm Opportunity

This role is all about managing staff rotas and ensuring shifts are covered across SEND programmes. Using Rotacloud, you'll schedule staff, advertise shifts, arrange cover for absences, and help ensure the right staffing levels are in place.

Key duties:
- Create and manage staff rotas
- Fill shifts and arrange sickness/holiday cover
- Liaise with managers on staffing requirements
- Build relationships with staff and answer rota queries
- Keep workforce records up to date
- Produce staffing reports and monitor staffing levels

Ideal background:
- Previous rota, scheduling or workforce planning experience
- Strong organisation and communication skills
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office and online systems
- Able to work under pressure and solve problems quickly

Experience in care, education, childcare, SEND or staffing coordination would be advantageous but is not essential. Full training will be provided.

This is a fantastic temp-to-perm opportunity for someone looking to join a growing organisation and make a real impact within a busy coordination role.

title: Project Support Administrator
description:
Belmont Recruitment are currently looking for a Project Support Administrator to join Bradford Council's Children and Family Service on an initial 3-6 month temporary contract. This is a full-time role working 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide project support to the delivery of projects and best value reviews within the Children and Families service.
- Work closely with Contract and Quality Officers to support the smooth delivery of review activity.
- Collect, collate and maintain accurate project and service information.
- Monitor project activity, progress and agreed actions.
- Support the recording and reporting of the impact and outcomes of best value reviews.
- Prepare reports, briefings and management information as required.
- Maintain project documentation, records, action logs and supporting evidence.
- Liaise with internal teams and stakeholders to gather information and ensure deadlines are met.
- Identify gaps, issues or concerns within project information and escalate where appropriate.
- Support meetings, including preparing information, recording actions and following up outstanding tasks.

Requirements:
- Experience providing project or business support.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience maintaining accurate records and project documentation.

Please apply with an up to date CV ASAP if this role would be of interest to you.

title: Medical Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Job Description This position is perfect for individuals who enjoy helping others, have a passion for health and wellness, and are looking for a team-based work environment. The Care Navigator will work with our clients to ensure that they receive the highest quality of care during their treatment, as well as provide them with all the resources and information they need, including scheduling appointments and helping to control the cost of their care. To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures. To work in accordance of written protocols. Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the Practice Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. Using your own judgment and communication skills ensure that patients with no prior appointment but who need urgent consultation are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Explain Practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Enter requests for home visits onto clinical system, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details and where necessary refer to Duty Doctor. Action repeat prescription requests and ensure that they are ready for collection by the patient within 48 hours, either on the computer or manually. Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non General Medical Services) services, accept payment and issue receipts for same. Enter patient information on to the computer as required, i.e. change of addresses, names, telephone numbers and any ad-hoc information as appropriate. Ensure the waiting room is kept tidy in turn with other staff members. Premises Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm. Open up premises at the start of the day when first to arrive, and make all necessary preparations to receive patients. When last to leave at the end of the day, ensure that the building is totally secured, and rooms are tidied and ready for the next day. Ensure that all new patients are registered onto the computer system promptly and accurately, including Temporary Residents. Contact patients for routine screening as appropriate. Do necessary administration of Pathology Data. Arranging transport for patients when necessary. Opening, stamping with date and action stamp all incoming post. Scan hospital letters and patient correspondence in accordance with Practice guidelines. Advising Office Manager when stationary or other equipment is required. Sending faxes to outside organisations when required. Filing clinical letters into relevant concertina files. Action tasks within a timely manner. Restock the reception area. Complete all annual Mandatory training as appropriate Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours Undertake any other additional duties appropriate to the post as requested by the Partners or the Practice Manager. This post requires clear DBS, really good previous references and clean employment track record.
